newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha helped by crude, mogas, but demand slo.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha helped by crude, mogas, but demand slo.

text.p: NWE naphtha was gaining support from firmer gasoline and crude markets on Friday, but fundamentally slow local demand was acting as a counter balance.
A shut arbitrage to Asia, which has drawn upwards of 800,000 tonnes since the window opened, was adding to the bearish demand factor.
NWE cargoes gained from the $173.50 cif seen yesterday.
"We are hearing offers of $175 now," said one dealer.
Activity has also thinned by a number of traders taking advantage of the Ascension day holiday on Thursday to make a long weekend by taking Friday off.
